tasks.subject: Task 0: Reset version + Foundry docs URL
tasks.description:
Set version.py to 0.1.0.dev with docs="0.1"; change docs URL base to https://docs.cafecito.games/foundry/en/ in core/core_builders.py:32 and modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py:326. Verify --version prints 0.1.0.dev.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["version.py", "core/core_builders.py", "modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --version", "acceptanceCriteria": ["version.py 0.1.0.dev docs=0.1", "docs URL base is foundry placeholder", "--version prints 0.1.0.dev"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Rename build binary godot -> foundry
tasks.description:
Change #bin/godot -> #bin/foundry in platform/{linuxbsd,macos,windows,web}/SCsub; rename macOS .app bundle prefix + inner exe + CFBundleExecutable. Verify bin/foundry.* emitted, no bin/godot.*, test suite passes.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["platform/linuxbsd/SCsub", "platform/macos/SCsub", "platform/windows/SCsub", "platform/web/SCsub", "platform/macos/platform_macos_builders.py", "misc/dist/macos_tools.app/Contents/Info.plist"], "verifyCommand": "ls bin/foundry.* && ./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no #bin/godot in platform/", "bin/foundry.* emitted", "macOS bundle Foundry-named", "test suite passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: De-godot CI workflows + composite actions
tasks.description:
git mv .github/actions/godot-* -> foundry-*; update uses: paths, bin/foundry paths, Godot->Foundry in name: fields. Keep godot-cpp/emsdk. Lint workflows.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/actions/", ".github/workflows/"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rn 'actions/godot-\\|bin/godot' .github", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no actions/godot- refs", "no bin/godot refs", "only external godot refs remain", "YAML lints"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Add release.yml pipeline
tasks.description:
New .github/workflows/release.yml: trigger on v* tag + workflow_dispatch; build all platforms reusing foundry-* actions; package editor archives + export-templates .tpz; publish GH Release (tag=auto, dispatch=draft). Lint.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/release.yml"], "verifyCommand": "actionlint .github/workflows/release.yml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["v* tag + dispatch triggers", "all-platform matrix", "templates .tpz + editor archives", "tag=auto dispatch=draft publish", "YAML lints"]}
```
